<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Feathered Flechettes](/Feats.aspx?ID=5532) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 83

**Archetype** [Winged Warrior](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=227)

**Frequency**
once per hour

**Prerequisites**
[Winged Warrior Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5527)

</column>

---

Unfurling your wings in a quick snap, you send feathers scattering in all directions. Creatures in a 15-foot emanation take 6d6 slashing damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC). This increases to 10d6 if your unarmed attacks have a [_greater striking_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) rune, such as by etching it onto [_handwraps of mighty blows_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3086), and 16d6 if they have a _major striking_ rune.
name: Feathered Flechettes
